title: Deep Learning versus Motif-Based Models for Promoter Sequence Recognition

contributions.purpose: 对比motif基线与神经网络识别启动子
contributions.mechanism: 合成5000条100bp序列(半含TATAAT motif),logistic(3-mer)vs 单隐层MLP(one-hot),5折
contributions.evaluation: Logistic acc 0.765±0.009/AUC 0.845 略胜 MLP acc 0.746±0.012/AUC 0.825
contributions.source_quote: We compare a neural network model to a classical motif-based classifier for identifying promoter DNA sequences

contributions.purpose: 提示DL不必然胜过经典基线
contributions.mechanism: 在信号简单的合成集上分析
contributions.evaluation: motif基线胜出,强调纳入经典基线的重要性(定性结论)
contributions.source_quote: deep learning does not automatically outperform classical baselines, especially when the signal is simple

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work complements these by directly comparing a simple motif-based baseline to a small neural network in a controlled synthetic setting.

notes: 无编号贡献列表,由abstract+discussion归纳2条。负结果:MLP不及logistic基线(acc 0.746 vs 0.765,AUC 0.825 vs 0.845),DL无额外增益。数据红旗:数据集完全由AI合成且人工植入TATAAT motif(可控可分,非真实基因组),作者自认'biological conclusions from this synthetic benchmark are limited';AI披露checklist(AI Contribution Disclosure)明写主体工作(设计/数据生成/建模/分析/成文/作图)全由GPT-5完成,人类仅高层监督——AI端到端自研+自造数据+自评。desk-reject。
